mapper.update: UPDATE message_stat SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{systemUserId} WHERE stat_date = #{statDate} AND NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message_stat ( total_send_count, total_success_count, billing_cost, max_cost, stat_date, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) SELECT NVL(SUM(sh.total_target_count), 0), NVL(SUM(sh.success_count), 0), NVL(SUM(sh.actual_cost), 0), NVL(SUM(sh.estimated_cost), 0), #{statDate}, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{systemUserId}, #{systemUserId}, 0 FROM send_history sh WHERE sh.status = 'SENT' AND TRUNC(sh.completed_at) = #{statDate} AND NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE message_stat_by_degree SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{systemUserId} WHERE stat_date = #{statDate} AND NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO message_stat_by_degree ( degree, send_count, success_count, stat_date, cost, channel_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) SELECT -- 몇 차 발송인지. 예: 1차, 2차 sa.attempt_order,
-- 해당 차수/채널로 발송을 시도한 전체 건수 COUNT(sa.id),
-- 해당 차수/채널 발송 시도 중 성공한 건수 SUM(CASE WHEN sa.is_succeeded = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),
-- 배치가 집계하는 기준 날짜 #{statDate},
-- 성공한 발송 시도에 대해서만 채널 단가를 합산한 비용 NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN sa.is_succeeded = 1 THEN c.cost_per_msg ELSE 0 END), 0),
-- 발송 시도에 사용된 채널 sa.channel_id, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{systemUserId}, #{systemUserId}, 0 FROM send_attempt sa -- send_attempt는 send_target_id를 통해 발송 대상과 연결된다. INNER JOIN send_target st ON st.id = sa.send_target_id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 -- send_target은 send_history_id를 통해 발송 묶음과 연결된다. INNER JOIN send_history sh ON sh.id = st.send_history_id AND NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0 -- channel은 채널 단가(cost_per_msg)를 계산하기 위해 연결한다. INNER JOIN channel c ON c.id = sa.channel_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 -- 완료된 발송 묶음만 통계에 포함한다. WHERE sh.status = 'SENT' -- completed_at은 시간까지 포함하므로 TRUNC로 날짜만 비교한다. AND TRUNC(sh.completed_at) = #{statDate} AND NVL(sa.is_deleted, 0) = 0 -- 차수와 채널별로 한 row씩 집계한다. GROUP BY sa.attempt_order, sa.channel_id
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_stat SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{systemUserId} WHERE stat_date = #{statDate} AND NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO customer_stat ( stat_date, total_customer_count, normal_customer_count, new_customer_count, dormant_customer_count, sms_consent_count, kakao_consent_count, email_consent_count, joined_customer_count, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) SELECT #{statDate},
-- statDate까지 가입한 전체 활성 고객 수 ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer c WHERE NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND TRUNC(c.joined_at) <= #{statDate} ),
-- 기존 고객 화면 기준과 맞춘 일반 고객 수 ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer c WHERE NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND TRUNC(c.joined_at) <= #{statDate} AND c.joined_at < CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '7' DAY AND ( c.last_active_at IS NULL OR c.last_active_at >= ADD_MONTHS(CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP), -12) ) ),
-- statDate 기준 최근 7일 이내 가입한 신규 고객 수 ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer c WHERE NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND TRUNC(c.joined_at) <= #{statDate} AND c.joined_at >= CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '7' DAY ),
-- 마지막 활동이 12개월보다 오래된 휴면 고객 수 ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer c WHERE NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND TRUNC(c.joined_at) <= #{statDate} AND c.joined_at < CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL '7' DAY AND c.last_active_at < ADD_MONTHS(CAST(#{statDate} AS TIMESTAMP), -12) ),
-- SMS 수신 동의 고객 수 ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.customer_id) FROM customer_channel_consent ccc INNER JOIN customer c ON c.id = ccc.customer_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND TRUNC(c.joined_at) <= #{statDate} INNER JOIN channel ch ON ch.id = ccc.channel_id AND NVL(ch.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE NVL(ccc.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND NVL(ccc.is_consented, 0) = 1 AND ch.channel_type = 'SMS' ),
-- 카카오 알림톡 수신 동의 고객 수 ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.customer_id) FROM customer_channel_consent ccc INNER JOIN customer c ON c.id = ccc.customer_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND TRUNC(c.joined_at) <= #{statDate} INNER JOIN channel ch ON ch.id = ccc.channel_id AND NVL(ch.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE NVL(ccc.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND NVL(ccc.is_consented, 0) = 1 AND ch.channel_type = 'KAKAO' ),
-- EMAIL 수신 동의 고객 수 ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.customer_id) FROM customer_channel_consent ccc INNER JOIN customer c ON c.id = ccc.customer_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND TRUNC(c.joined_at) <= #{statDate} INNER JOIN channel ch ON ch.id = ccc.channel_id AND NVL(ch.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE NVL(ccc.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND NVL(ccc.is_consented, 0) = 1 AND ch.channel_type = 'EMAIL' ),
-- statDate 당일 가입한 고객 수 ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer c WHERE NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND TRUNC(c.joined_at) = #{statDate} ),
SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{systemUserId}, #{systemUserId}, 0 FROM dual
mapper.update: UPDATE channel_stat SET is_deleted = 1, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{systemUserId} WHERE NVL(is_deleted, 0) = 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO channel_stat ( click_target_count, click_count, conversion_target_count, conversion_count, consent_target_count, consent_count, channel_id, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by, is_deleted ) SELECT NVL(url_stat.click_target_count, 0), NVL(url_stat.click_count, 0), NVL(url_stat.conversion_target_count, 0), NVL(url_stat.conversion_count, 0), NVL(consent_stat.consent_target_count, 0), NVL(consent_stat.consent_count, 0), ch.id, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP, #{systemUserId}, #{systemUserId}, 0 FROM channel ch LEFT JOIN ( SELECT st.final_channel_id AS channel_id, COUNT(su.id) AS click_target_count, SUM(CASE WHEN su.is_clicked = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS click_count, COUNT(su.id) AS conversion_target_count, SUM(CASE WHEN NVL(su.is_converted, 0) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conversion_count FROM short_url su INNER JOIN send_target st ON st.id = su.send_target_id AND NVL(st.is_deleted, 0) = 0 INNER JOIN send_history sh ON sh.id = st.send_history_id AND NVL(sh.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE NVL(su.is_deleted, 0) = 0 AND sh.status = 'SENT' AND st.final_channel_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY st.final_channel_id ) url_stat ON url_stat.channel_id = ch.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ccc.channel_id, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.customer_id) AS consent_target_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NVL(ccc.is_consented, 0) = 1 THEN ccc.customer_id END) AS consent_count FROM customer_channel_consent ccc INNER JOIN customer c ON c.id = ccc.customer_id AND NVL(c.is_deleted, 0) = 0 WHERE NVL(ccc.is_deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY ccc.channel_id ) consent_stat ON consent_stat.channel_id = ch.id WHERE NVL(ch.is_deleted, 0) = 0
